description: The authoritative Google Search Console connection check for this workspace: whether GSC OAuth is configured server-side, whether THIS workspace has connected (`connected`), and the verified GSC properties (site URLs / sc-domain: properties) available to query. A workspace can connect SEVERAL Google accounts — `connections[]` lists each one with its own email and properties, while `email` and `sites` summarise the first account and the union. A domain is readable when ANY connected account holds a property for it, so judge coverage from `sites`, not from one account. whoami does not report GSC state — this tool is the truthful signal.
name: gsc_status
